hero:
ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE · THE BIG PICTURE

A machine receives information, finds patterns, and chooses a useful response.

AI is broader than chatbots: it includes perception, reasoning, learning, language, and automated decisions.

questions.stem: Artificial Intelligence (AI) అంటే ఏమిటి? Reasoning, Learning, Perception, Decision-Making వంటి Human Intelligence అవసరమయ్యే Tasksని Machines ఎలా Perform చేస్తాయి?
options: Instructions Follow చేసే Every Computer Programనే AI అంటారు; Learning అవసరం ఉండదు.
Reasoning, Learning, Perception, Decisions వంటి Tasks Machines చేయడమే AI.
AI అంటే Roomsలో తిరిగే Physical Robots మాత్రమే; Software Models కాదు.
Information Store చేసే Normal Websites అన్నీ Automatically Intelligent Systems అవుతాయి.
questions.figure:
01 · BEGINNER · MEANING

A crosswalk camera is one example of AI-assisted perception and action

The system does not need human consciousness. Recognizing a person and helping decide when crossing is safe can count as AI.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: AI అంటే Computers Intelligentగా అనిపించే Tasks చేయడం. Example: Spam Emails Identify చేయడం, Photosలో Objects Recognize చేయడం.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: B. AI Systems Perception, Language, Learning, Reasoning, Decision Making వంటి Capabilities Develop చేస్తాయి. Human-shaped Robot లేదా Consciousness తప్పనిసరి కాదు. Spam Filter కూడా AI Application.

questions.stem: Artificial Intelligence Research ఎప్పుడు Start అయింది? Alan Turing, Dartmouth Workshop, Expert Systems, Deep Learning, Modern Transformers వంటి Milestones AI Developmentని ఎలా Change చేశాయి?
options: AI Modern Chatbotsతోనే First Start అయింది; Earlier Computing Researchని Entirely Ignore చేస్తుంది.
AI Robotics Motor Hardware Improvements వల్ల మాత్రమే Introduce అయింది.
AI Internet Search Engines తర్వాతే వచ్చింది; Older Theory ఏదీ లేదు.
Turing, Dartmouth, Expert Systems, Deep Learning, Transformersతో AI Develop అయింది.
questions.figure:
02 · BEGINNER · EVOLUTION

From Turing and Dartmouth to deep learning and Transformers

The term AI appears in the 1955 Dartmouth proposal, with the workshop held in 1956. These are selected historical milestones, not a complete timeline.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: AI ఒక్క రోజులో Develop కాలేదు. Turing Ideas నుంచి Research, Expert Systems, Deep Learning, Transformers వరకు Many Breakthroughs వచ్చాయి.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: D. Alan Turing 1950లో Machine Intelligence గురించి Discuss చేశారు. Dartmouth Workshop Proposal 1955లో వచ్చి 1956లో Meeting జరిగింది. Expert Systems, Deep Blue, AlexNet, 2017 Transformer, 2022 ChatGPT తరువాతి Milestones.

questions.stem: AI System Input తీసుకుని Process చేసి Prediction, Response లేదా Action ఎలా Generate చేస్తుంది? Traditional Rule-Based Programmingతో Difference ఏమిటి?
options: AI Inputsని Rules లేదా Learned Modelsతో Process చేసి Predictions లేదా Actions ఇస్తుంది.
AI Inputsని Change చేయకుండా Store చేస్తుంది; Traditional Programs Examples నుంచి Learn చేస్తాయి.
AI Always Text మాత్రమే Generate చేస్తుంది; Numbers, Actions Process చేయలేదు.
AI Only Images Accept చేస్తుంది; Other Data Typesని Process చేయలేదు.
questions.figure:
03 · BEGINNER · HOW IT WORKS

A fixed rule and a learned classifier can process the same email

Rules use programmer-written conditions; machine learning fits patterns from data. Both can be parts of an AI system.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: AI Input తీసుకుని Rules లేదా Learned Patternsతో Process చేసి Output ఇస్తుంది. Example: Email Spamనా కాదా Predict చేస్తుంది.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: A. Input → Representation/Processing → Prediction/Action అనే Pipeline Common. Traditional Software Usually Explicit Rules Follow చేస్తుంది; Machine Learning Data నుంచి Patterns Learn చేస్తుంది. Rule-Based AI కూడా ఉంది కాబట్టి Difference Absolute కాదు.

questions.stem: Symbolic AI, Rule-Based Systems, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Probabilistic Reasoning, Hybrid AI Approaches మధ్య Principles, Capabilities ఎలా Differ అవుతాయి?
options: Symbolic AI Images నుంచి Weights Learn చేస్తుంది; Deep Learning Unchanging Handcrafted Rules మాత్రమే Follow చేస్తుంది.
All AI Approaches Neural Networks మాత్రమే Use చేస్తాయి; Layers Numberతో Differ అవుతాయి.
Rules Knowledge Represent చేస్తాయి, Learning Examplesని Fit చేస్తుంది, Probabilities Uncertainty Handle చేస్తాయి.
Probabilistic AI Uncertainty Represent చేయలేదు; Hybrid Models Different Approaches Combine చేయవు.
questions.figure:
04 · MEDIUM · SIX APPROACHES

Some AI systems use logic; others learn patterns or model uncertainty

No single method is best for every task. Hybrid systems combine strengths such as explicit rules, statistical learning, and probabilistic reasoning.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: కొన్ని AI Systems Rules Follow అవుతాయి; కొన్ని Examples నుంచి Learn చేస్తాయి. Probabilistic Methods Uncertainty Handle చేస్తాయి; Hybrid Systems Combine చేస్తాయి.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: C. Symbolic AI Logic, Authored Rules Use చేస్తుంది. ML Data నుంచి Patterns Fit చేస్తుంది; Deep Learning Multi-Layer Neural Nets Use చేస్తుంది. Probabilistic Methods Uncertainty Model చేస్తాయి; Hybrid AI వాటిని Combine చేస్తుంది.

questions.stem: Pythonలో Simple AI System Build చేయడానికి Problem Define, Data Collect, AI Method Choose, Train, Test, Evaluate Steps ఎలా Follow అవుతాయి?
options: Largest Modelని Select చేసి Data Quality, Evaluationని Completely Skip చేస్తాం.
Problem, Data, Method Define చేసి Model Train లేదా Program చేసి Evaluate చేస్తాం.
Logo Design First చేసి Performanceని Testing లేకుండా Guess చేస్తాం.
Evaluation Metrics Define చేయకుండా Direct Deployment చేసి Accuracy Assume చేస్తాం, Testing లేకుండా.
questions.figure:
05 · MEDIUM · BUILD AND TEST

A flower-classifying AI can be trained and tested using Python

Python · small, runnable classification example
from sklearn.datasets import load_iris
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score

X, y = load_iris(return_X_y=True)
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=y
)
model = DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=3, random_state=42)
model.fit(X_train, y_train)
prediction = model.predict(X_test)
print("Test accuracy:", round(accuracy_score(y_test, prediction), 2))

Keep test examples separate from training. An evaluation metric tells you how well the toy system performs on unseen cases.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: First Problem Clearly Define చేయండి. Relevant Data, Suitable Method Choose చేసి Train చేయండి. Separate Test Dataతో Result Evaluate చేయండి.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: B. Clear Task, Success Metric, Quality Data, Suitable Algorithm, Training, Held-Out Evaluation అవసరం. Python Scikit-learnతో Iris Classification ఒక Toy Example; Good Toy Accuracy Production Guarantee కాదు.

questions.stem: Modern AI Systemsలో Perception, Knowledge, Memory, Reasoning, Planning, Learning, Autonomous Actions ఎలా Combine అవుతాయి? వాటి Integrationలో ఏ Challenges ఉంటాయి?
options: Perception, Memory, Planning, Action Modules మధ్య Information Exchange లేకపోతే System Best Work చేస్తుంది.
Agentకి Perception మాత్రమే అవసరం; Memory, Learning, Planning Useful కావు.
Modules Combine చేస్తే All Errors Disappear అవుతాయి; Coordination Problem ఉండదు.
Agents Perception, Memory, Planning, Actions Connect చేస్తాయి; Feedback, Uncertainty Challenges ఉంటాయి.
questions.figure:
06 · ADVANCED · INTEGRATED CAPABILITIES

Perception, memory, reasoning, planning and action work as a coordinated loop

Integrated systems must handle uncertainty, stale information, time limits, unreliable tools, and safety constraints.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: AI Agent Information Observe చేసి, Memory Use చేసి, Plan చేసి Action తీసుకోవచ్చు. Modules Reliableగా Coordinate కావడం Challenging.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: D. Modern Agentsలో Perception, Memory, Knowledge, Planning, Tool Actions, Feedback Learning Combine అవుతాయి. Real Challenges: Stale Observations, Conflicting Data, Latency, Authorization, Safety, Unreliable Tools.

questions.stem: AIలో Generalization, Reasoning Reliability, Common-Sense, Interpretability, Robustness, Alignment, AGI వంటి Open Challenges ఏమిటి? Researchers వాటిని ఎలా Address చేస్తున్నారు?
options: Reliability, Robustness, Explainability, Generalization Problemsపై Research, Testing, Safeguards కొనసాగుతున్నాయి.
Larger Models ఉన్నప్పుడు All AI Limitations Completely Disappear అవుతాయి; Testing అవసరం లేదు, స్వతంత్రధృవీకరణలేకుండానే.
AGI ఇప్పటికే Universally Achieved అయింది; Meaningful Research Questions ఏవీ లేవు.
AI Research Hardware Speed గురించే ఉంటుంది; Reasoning, Alignment Problems Already Solved.
questions.figure:
07 · ADVANCED · LIMITATIONS

Six unresolved challenges researchers still investigate

Better testing, calibration, verification, interpretability and oversight can reduce failures—but scaling alone cannot guarantee reliability, alignment, or AGI.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: AI Confidentగా Wrong Answers ఇవ్వవచ్చు; New Situationsలో Fail అవచ్చు. Better Evaluation, Robust Training, Safeguardsతో Researchers Improve చేస్తున్నారు.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: A. Generalization Errors, Distribution Shift, Confident Hallucinations, Common-Sense Gaps, Interpretability, Robustness Open Problems. Researchలో Benchmark Testing, Verification, Grounding, Uncertainty Estimation, Alignmentపై Work కొనసాగుతోంది. AGI Definition/Statusపై Consensus లేదు.
